proposal:
This is a test region I am running with the N media and emotron para kete V three model. This is a native multimodal model, and latest logs show that there has been a streaming functionality which we have integrated bit in typel. Streaming basically helps ingest processing the speech through text in the background, so that whenever a long distrition is completed, it transcribes it immediately with the help of background processing and thereby takes the load of the processing once it finishes transcription, making it feel faster instead.

So dictating it over for thirty seconds, so let's see how well it is working right now. I have done as per your bidding and I have executed all the partial commands right now, so let's see how well it works and how well its v three buffer streaming is implemented as an experiment with patch decoding kept as a defaul because it retained more internal words in the long reference. There is no need to repeat the full accuracy metrix to try streaming restrock the work tree.
